7 Brew Heatwave 7 Energy: Price, Calories & Caffeine

A medium Heatwave 7 Energy is about $5.25, with 230 calories, 105 mg of caffeine and 57 g of sugar. Every number here comes from 7 Brew's own published nutrition guide, broken out by size and preparation.

Heatwave 7 Energy allergens

7 Brew's published allergen guide lists no declared allergens for the standard Heatwave 7 Energy. Adding a milk, syrup or topping changes this, and every drink is made on shared equipment, so cross-contact is possible.

If you are ordering around an allergy, check the full allergen and dietary guide and confirm at the window.

How to order a Heatwave 7 Energy

Ask for it by name — it is on the standard board at every 7 Brew, so no special script is needed. Say the size first, then the drink: "Can I get a medium Heatwave 7 Energy?"

Worth knowing before you order: the base is customisable. You can swap milk, ask for sugar-free syrups, change the sweetness level, or have most drinks made iced, hot or blended as a frozen chiller where the menu allows. Ordering through the app earns 100 rewards points either way.

Make a Heatwave at Home (Citrus Build)

No official ratio is published, so this is a home method modeled on the official flavor trio: orange, lime and lemon concentrate on an energy base. Keep it sharp; sugar is where home versions usually go wrong.

For one medium Heatwave

  • ½ oz orange syrup
  • ¼ oz lime syrup, or the juice of half a lime
  • ¼ oz lemon syrup or a squeeze of lemon concentrate
  • About 11 oz energy drink
  • A full cup of ice
  1. Pour the citrus flavors over the ice.
  2. Add the energy drink and stir once. Do not shake; it foams and goes flat.
  3. Taste before adding anything sweet. The stand version is sweet enough at half these syrup amounts for most people.

Chiller version: blend the whole thing with the ice instead of pouring over it. Expect a softer citrus hit, the same trade the stand's chiller makes.

7 Brew Heatwave 7 Energy FAQ

How many calories are in a 7 Brew Heatwave 7 Energy?

A medium iced Heatwave 7 Energy has 230 calories. A small has 180 and a large 360, according to 7 Brew's nutrition guide.

How much caffeine is in a 7 Brew Heatwave 7 Energy?

About 105 mg in a medium. Small is 67 mg and large is 133 mg.

How much does a 7 Brew Heatwave 7 Energy cost?

Roughly $4.50 for a small, $5.25 for a medium and $6.25 for a large. Prices are our estimates and vary by stand — every 7 Brew is independently owned.

How much sugar is in a 7 Brew Heatwave 7 Energy?

57 g in a medium.

Is Heatwave spicy?

No. There is no chili, pepper or heat of any kind in it. The name is a summer name. The official menu card lists the flavor as orange, lime and lemon concentrate, a straight citrus punch on the 7 Energy base. Watch out for two fan sites that build Heatwave as pineapple and coconut; that is a tropical mix-up, not this drink.

Is there a sugar-free Heatwave?

Not an official one. 7 Brew's nutrition guide publishes no sugar-free Heatwave at all, unlike Brewberry, which has a full sugar-free entry. The lemon concentrate flavor is the sticking point; stand staff in fan discussions say the Heatwave flavors cannot be made sugar-free. You can still cut the sugar hard: order it half sweet or quarter sweet, which fans rate as the sweet spot anyway, since full sweet buries the citrus. Every drink that does offer a sugar-free version is compared on our sugar-free page.

Does the Frozen Chiller version have less caffeine?

Yes, on the guide's own rows. Iced Heatwave runs 67 mg in a small, 105 in a medium and 133 in a large. The Frozen Chiller rows read 36, 36 and 71 mg, because the blended ice and mix take up cup room that the energy base fills in the iced version. If caffeine is the point of the order, get it iced.

What is the best way to order a Heatwave?

Iced, half sweet, light ice is the order fans land on again and again. Half sweet lets the lime and lemon show up instead of just sugar, and light ice means more drink in the cup. The same flavor also comes as a Heatwave Lemonade, if you want the citrus without the energy base.

How do I make a Heatwave at home?

Use the three citrus flavors on an energy base and keep it sharp. The recipe section on this page gives a home method modeled on the official flavor trio: orange syrup, lime, and lemon, stirred over ice. Nobody official publishes the stand's exact ratio, so treat it as a close copy, not the original.
